title: hazard.spawned
description: M5 § hazard.* family — declarative event schema locked at v0.1. 9 hazard kinds (locked): fire, smoke, electric, wet, hot, cold, acid, radiation, toxic. The 5-launch subset for M16-launch is {fire, smoke, electric, wet, hot|cold}; M16 extends to 9 by adding acid, radiation, toxic. The spec bullet's 'hot_cold' single-token name is split into 'hot' + 'cold' here; the spec bullet's 'radiation_zone' / 'toxic_atmosphere' bullet names are short-form 'radiation' / 'toxic' in this enum. Producer fills at M16. Additive-only per M4 DR-002.
